run_get_current_version: run the release utils CLI to get the current version and tag from version.txt
run_get_next_version: run the release utils CLI with --release-type patch to compute the next version number
run_update_version: run the release utils CLI with --update-version to write the new version to version.txt
run_release_major: run the release utils CLI with --release-type major to bump the major version number
run_release_minor: run the release utils CLI with --release-type minor to bump the minor version number
